scripts.start: concurrently "npm run build:common" "npm run start:api" "npm run start:ui"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:api && npm run lint:ui && npm run lint:common
scripts.types: npm run types:api && npm run types:ui && npm run types:common
scripts.common:prod: concurrently "cd terrazzo-api && npm run common:prod" "cd terrazzo-ui && npm run common:prod"
scripts.common:dev: concurrently "cd terrazzo-api && npm run common:dev" "cd terrazzo-ui && npm run common:dev"
scripts.postinstall: concurrently "cd terrazzo-common && npm i" "cd terrazzo-db && npm i" "cd terrazzo-api && npm i" "cd terrazzo-ui && npm i"
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:ui && npm run test:common
